messages:
nora (People Ops): Heads-up: guidance for handling probationary hires and employees who joined mid-review cycle. This came up in a few manager syncs — posting the rules and intake flow so everyone has a reference. :seedling:

ethan (Eng Manager): Thanks. We just onboarded two new hires who started 6 weeks ago. Do they get a full review this cycle?

nora (People Ops): Short answer: no. Policy summary: employees with < 90 days service at the start of the review window are in the 'mid-cycle' bucket. They receive a qualitative note and growth plan, not a calibrated rating. If managers want a formal rating (exception), follow the rating-exception flow and cc People Ops.

bel (People Ops): Flow and naming: if you want to submit any input for a probationary employee, use the MID_<lastname>_<YYYYMMDD>_<mgrInit> filename pattern and include top-matter: reviewer_name | manager_name | start_date | days_in_role | recommended_action (note/growth-plan/exception). Example: MID_Kim_20260803_EP

samir (Manager): What about comp eligibility or promo windows? Will excluding them from calibration affect salary discussions?

nora (People Ops): Excluding from calibration doesn't block comp conversations. Manager recommendations for comp or early promo need explicit HR approval. If you believe a new hire merits comp action, file an exception with supporting evidence and the manager must be prepared to present samples (projects, client metrics). People Ops will route to comp.

ethan (Eng Manager): A practical edge: we rotate senior ICs to mentor new hires and sometimes mentors want to include peer feedback on the new hire. Is that allowed in the MID file?

bel (People Ops): Yes. You can include structured peer notes in MID files. Please anonymize where peers requested privacy and include a manager confirmation line that you reviewed originals. Peer feedback in MID files is considered developmental input, not calibration material.

forms-bot: upload guideline: accepted patterns for mid-cycle files: MID_<lastname>_<YYYYMMDD>_<mgrInit>. Parser will extract start_date and days_in_role if present in top-matter. receipts will include UTC timestamp.

samir (Manager): If a new hire started before the review window but on a different team (internal transfer) and they have > 90 days total company service, do we include them in calibration?

nora (People Ops): Yes — use company service start date to determine the 90-day threshold. Transfers with > 90 days are treated like regular contributors for the cycle. Transfers with < 90 days use the MID bucket. Note this is about fairness across teams.

ethan (Eng Manager): One weird case: we have a contractor who converted to FTE mid-cycle. Their contractor performance is strong. Do we include contractor period as part of 90 days?

bel (People Ops): Conversions: count company service from the start date (contractor onboarding counted) only if the conversion paperwork shows continuous service and HR records the conversion effective retroactively. If conversion is effective after handback, treat as MID unless HR confirms continuity. DM me the payroll case if you have a concrete example.

samir (Manager): Suppose we do submit an exception for a probationary hire and the appeals or calibration committee approves a rating. Will that retroactively affect distribution for the team?

nora (People Ops): Any granted rating exceptions for MID cases are logged and may affect local distribution. We generally avoid retroactive company-level redistribution for single-case exceptions unless aggregate impact crosses the normal threshold. People Ops will notify affected managers and comp if distribution moves materially.

ethan (Eng Manager): Are there template prompts or growth-plan templates we should attach for MID files? Would help standardize manager notes.

bel (People Ops): Yes  we published a short MID template in the Review Console under Resources > MID Templates. It has sections: Summary (2-3 lines), Achievements (bulleted), Development plan (3 month goals), Support needed. Paste into top of MID file under header 'MID_TEMPLATE' so intake picks it up.

forms-bot: example receipt: MID_Ortiz_20260803_EP.pdf  receipt id: m9d3-fa7b  uploaded: 2026-08-03T14:12:03Z (UTC)

samir (Manager): Last Q: for managers with many new hires, can we request a combined MID packet to save time? For example, one file with multiple MID entries?

bel (People Ops): Combined MID files are fine if each entry has clear top-matter and separator lines. Use '---' between entries and ensure each entry follows the filename pattern in its header and include a manager confirmation line per person. For parsing reliability we prefer individual files but will accept combined in bulk cases. Let People Ops know if you plan bulk uploads so we can watch the intake queue.

nora (People Ops): Thanks all. We'll add this guidance to the Manager FAQ and pin the MID template in Review Console. If you have borderline cases DM me or @bel with a 1-line summary and we'll advise. :memo:
